products.name: Personalized Anniversary Calendar Embroidery Hoop
products.description: Exquisite handcrafted wooden hoop art with custom calendar date circled in red embroidery thread. Decorated with delicate French knot floral garland and customized couple names.

products.name: Daisy Meadow Hand-Embroidered Linen Hair Bows (Pair)
products.description: Delicate pair of handmade natural linen hair bows adorned with hand-stitched wild daisies, botanical vines, and soft frayed edges. Ideal for festive and everyday hair styling.

products.name: Bohemian Dip-Dyed Rose Quartz Dreamcatcher
products.description: Intricately woven mandala lace web centered with genuine polished crystal and natural wooden beads. Features cascading ombre dip-dyed rose-gold and cream macrame fringe tassels.

products.name: Golden Monogram Couple Floral Hoop Wall Hanging
products.description: Romantic couple name hoop art embroidered in lustrous metallic gold thread, embraced by an asymmetrical wreath of eucalyptus leaves and blush roses on organic cotton.

products.name: Artisanal Velvet Honeybee & Wildflower Hair Clips (Trio)
products.description: Luxury trio of plush velvet hair clips in sage green, dusty rose, and mustard yellow. Each clip is hand-stitched with miniature golden honeybees and vibrant wildflower French knots.

products.name: Celestial Dusk Crescent Moon Macrame Hanging
products.description: Handcrafted golden wire crescent moon frame with micro-macrame woven web, iridescent crystal beads, and flowing twilight purple-to-pink gradient silk tassels with star charms.

products.name: Personalized Wedding Vows Keepsake Hoop Art
products.description: Preserve your sacred promises in timeless hand-embroidery. Custom script lettering framed by romantic botanical laurel on pure Irish linen.

products.name: Vintage Heirloom Dusty Rose Embroidered Bow
products.description: Oversized statement hair bow crafted from premium textured cotton linen with intricate hand-embroidered climbing tea roses and bud clusters.

products.name: Tribal Sun & Feather Hanging with Wooden Beads
products.description: Traditional circular dreamcatcher crafted with natural willow hoop, intricate web weave, cruelty-free feathers, and hand-carved sandalwood beads.

products.name: Baby Birth Announcement Floral Embroidery Hoop
products.description: Celebrate the arrival of your little one with a customized birth details hoop: date, time, weight, and baby name framed by sweet pastel nursery flowers.

products.name: Lavender Sprig Hand-Stitched Alligator Clips
products.description: Set of 2 boutique alligator clips wrapped in soft cream linen, hand-embroidered with fragrant purple lavender sprigs and sage green leaves.

products.name: Aurora Borealis Ombre Macrame Dreamcatcher
products.description: Mesmerizing multi-tiered wall hanging combining intricate macrame knotting with dip-dyed teal, violet, and blush fringe tassels.
